title: AKEL district protest on housing policy at Presidential Palace
organizer: AKEL Nicosia-Kyrenia district committees and EDON Nicosia-Kyrenia

occurrence.value: FES reports organizers set up tents at the Presidential Palace entrance and submitted a memorandum to a government representative.

organizer.value: AKEL Nicosia-Kyrenia district committees and EDON Nicosia-Kyrenia

demands.value: Housing affordability and state housing policy; proposals included taxation of idle property, public land for affordable housing and stronger housing finance.

state_target.value: Direct appeal and memorandum to government representative; state housing policy demand.

state_response.value: No response or force reported in captured passage; unknown.

continuity.value: Part of a pan-Cypriot AKEL housing campaign through May 29; no evidence that this particular gathering lasted beyond May17.

protester_violence.value: No report identified in captured scope; code remains unknown.

limitations.value: Public action and government target are body-verified; threshold unknown.

title: Bicommunal demonstrations for crossing points and reunification
location: Two demonstrations on both sides of the Green Line near Ledra Palace / Nicosia crossing
organizer: Peace Generation United by Hope, Bi-communal Peace Initiative United Cyprus and allied groups

occurrence.value: FES and Peoples Dispatch independently describe demonstrations on both sides of the Green Line.

attendance.value: Unknown: FES says about 110 political parties and organizations supported the rally; this is not participant turnout.

location.value: Two demonstrations on both sides of the Green Line near Ledra Palace / Nicosia crossing

organizer.value: Peace Generation United by Hope, Bi-communal Peace Initiative United Cyprus and allied groups

demands.value: Open new crossing points, streamline procedures, and reunify Cyprus within a bi-zonal, bi-communal federal solution.

state_target.value: Demand addresses leaders and Cyprus settlement/crossing policy; own-state target plausible but the action spans both administrations and one side’s jurisdiction is contested.

state_response.value: No state response, arrests, violence or dispersal identified in cited scope; unknown.

continuity.value: Same-day paired actions, not presumed one physical crowd; no other dated continuation found.

protester_violence.value: No report identified in captured scope; code remains unknown.

limitations.value: Occurrence and demands have two reports, but the essential ≥50 simultaneous attendance is unresolved. Organization count cannot proxy attendance.
